async function run(groups, read) {
 for (const batch of groups) {
  const tasks = batch.filter(valid).map(read);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(tasks);
 }
 for (const batch of groups) {
  const tasks = other.map(read);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(tasks);
 }
 for (const batch of groups) {
  const tasks = batch.map(read);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await inspect(batch);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(tasks);
 }
}
